subject: dsa
title: Longest Consecutive Sequence
summary: Put every value in a hash set, then only start counting a run at a number whose predecessor is absent. Walking each run once from its true start makes the whole thing O(n) despite looking nested.
problem: Find the length of the longest run of consecutive integers in an unsorted array, in O(n) time.

steps.caption: Find the longest run of consecutive integers. Drop every value into a hash set so checking 'is x present?' is O(1).
Only begin a count at a number with no predecessor in the set, a true start. 1 qualifies (0 is absent), and so do 100 and 200.
Start at 1 and walk upward while the next value exists: 2, then 3, then 4 are all in the set.
5 is not in the set, so this run stops. Its length is 4.
The runs from 100 and 200 are length 1 each. The longest consecutive sequence is 1-2-3-4, length 4.
